In Square, our investments in distribution expansion are beginning to compound, and we expect to accelerate GPV growth for the third consecutive year, with gross profit growing roughly in line with GPV.

In Cash App, we expect at least low-single-digit actives growth and strong growth in both Commerce Enablement and Financial Solutions gross profit. 8 Neighborhoods has started to connect Square and Cash App, while our investments in AI are laying the foundation for what we believe will become Block’s next ecosystem.

Every annual Square loan cohort has performed in line with or better than our 4% loss target, and we’ve been able to grow Square Loans at a 27% CAGR over the past decade because of our disciplined underwriting approach, proprietary data, and world-class expertise.
